mapper.select: SELECT po.id, po.order_no, po.lease_agreement_id, po.subject, po.amount_total, po.success_time, ai.name AS apartment_name, ri.room_number FROM payment_order po LEFT JOIN lease_agreement la ON po.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND la.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON la.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON ri.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND po.status = 1 AND la.phone = #{phone} ORDER BY po.success_time DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(po.amount_total), 0) FROM payment_order po LEFT JOIN lease_agreement la ON po.lease_agreement_id = la.id AND la.is_deleted = 0 WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND po.status = 1 AND la.phone = #{phone}
